text:
A research submarine is at a depth of 10000m below the surface of the sea.
The average density of the water above the submarine is 1030kg/m3.
The atmospheric pressure at the surface of the sea is 103000Pa.
How many times greater is the pressure due to the sea water than the atmospheric pressure?
A
10
B
100
C
1000
D
100000
subject: Physics
